title: Guard session-recovery allowlist against production failure-factory drift
outcome: Guard session-recovery allowlist against production failure-factory drift
acceptance: Regression coverage exercises actual startup/index/retirement/proxy failure factories and checks explicit intended session-recovery eligibility; adding or changing a relevant production cause cannot silently strand a recoverable session. Keep intentional advice/eligibility divergences explicit rather than restoring Retryable as the policy.

completion.summary: Shared production launch/report factories are used by Bootstrap and Proxy; tests characterize all four fields and wording, nullable/numeric process codes and report-path inner exceptions. Actual startup/index/retirement/proxy factory tests use explicit cause-policy expectations independent of retryable, with exhaustive IndexStartupFailureCause coverage. Removing an actual writer-unavailable allowlist entry caused the intended factory guard failure. Coverage guards current relevant producers, not every conceivable future ad-hoc constructor; launch-path inner-exception preservation remains source-inspected. Final complete gates and fresh Codex/Claude full-union review passed. New Low CLI test/doc follow-up is tracked separately as w-129583275429. Implemented and reviewed; not committed or pushed.
